options.name: name
options.label: tableHeader_name
options.onValidate:
/* sample code */
  /*
  if ((value > 100) || (value < 0)) {
    callback(new Error('error message'))  //fail
  } else {
    callback();  //pass
  }
  */
  const sqlKeys = [
    'ALL',
    'AND',
    'AS',
    'ASC',
    'BETWEEN',
    'BY',
    'CASE',
    'DELETE',
    'DESC',
    'DISTINCT',
    'FROM',
    'GROUP',
    'HAVING',
    'IN',
    'INSERT',
    'INTO',
    'IS',
    'JOIN',
    'LEFT',
    'LIKE',
    'LIMIT',
    'NOT',
    'NULL',
    'OR',
    'ORDER',
    'OUTER',
    'SELECT',
    'SET',
    'TABLE',
    'UPDATE',
    'VALUES'
  ]
  if(sqlKeys.includes(value)) callback(new Error($t('tip.attributeNameFillingRuleDisabled'))) 
  else if(!/^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/.test(value)) callback(new Error($t('tip.attributeNameFillingRule'))) 
  else callback();
